description: Export architecture documents to professional Word (.docx) files: "export architecture to Word", "export handoff to Word", "stakeholder briefing", "generate .docx". On-demand only — never runs automatically. Two modes: Solution Architecture (a bounded role-routed stakeholder briefing for Product Owners, chapter leads and technical owners, its companion architecture reference, then individual ADR docs) and Handoff (the four-part handoff kit). Content is extracted verbatim from existing files. This skill only produces .docx files. A request to release, publish, ship, tag, freeze, bump or finalize an architecture version is a release, not an export: it routes to `architecture-docs` (`architecture-lifecycle`).
